topPRs.title: feat(viem): support OP Stack Upgrade 22 (Lagoon) and viem 2.58.2
topPRs.author: sbvegan
topPRs.body:
## Summary

Brings `@eth-optimism/viem` up to the current viem release and to OP Stack Upgrade 22 (Lagoon), so app developers can use it for interop between OP Mainnet and Unichain and for withdrawals after the shared-contract migration.

Lagoon timing, from the [Upgrade 22 notice](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/24328):
- **Shared-contract migration** (OP Mainnet and Unichain move to a shared `DisputeGameFactory`): Sepolia 2026-12-08, Mainnet 2026-12-14.
- **Lagoon activation** (interop between OP Mainnet and Unichain): Sepolia 2026-12-10, Mainnet 2027-01-11.
- **ZK dispute game (type `10`) becomes the respected game type:** Sepolia 2026-12-11, Mainnet 2027-01-14.

Contracts were checked against `ethereum-optimism/optimism` `develop` at `65e8033` (`packages/contracts-bedrock`) and the specs at `ethereum-optimism/specs` `f4b6735`.

## Changes

The peer range is `^2.58.2`, the current latest viem release. The upstream factory and game-type `10` fix (wevm/viem#5625) is merged but not yet released; see *Left to do*.

### 1. viem `^2.17.9` → `^2.58.2`
- Raises the `viem` dependency and peer range to `^2.58.2`.
- **Gas estimation fix.** viem 2.58 fills transactions with `eth_fillTransaction`, which estimates gas with no gas price. `CrossL2Inbox.validateMessage` reverts with `CrossL2Inbox_NoExecutingDeposits` when `tx.gasprice == 0` and the base fee is positive (`src/L2/CrossL2Inbox.sol`). As a result, `relayCrossDomainMessage` failed under the new viem. `baseWriteAction`, `estimateRelayCrossDomainMessageGas`, and `simulateRelayCrossDomainMessage` now fill the EIP-1559 fees the caller did not set before estimating. Caller-set fees are used as given.
- Two tests asserted an old viem `parseEventLogs` bug, and their TODOs said so. viem fixed the bug, so the assertions now expect one `SentMessageExtension1` log.
- Workspace dependents with their own viem pin now use the same version: `packages/wagmi`, `apps/autorelayer-interop`, and `apps/superchain-playground`. Without that, nx `build` and `typecheck` failed on mismatched viem types. No code changes were needed there.
- **No duplicated upstream code was found.** The chains already spread `viem/op-stack`'s `chainConfig`, so they use upstream formatters, serializers, and L1 and L2 actions. The package's own actions (ERC20 deposits and withdrawals, interop) have no upstream equivalent.

### 2. Interop actions and ABIs for Lagoon
Sources: `L2ToL2CrossDomainMessenger.sol`, `SuperchainETHBridge.sol`, `ETHLiquidity.sol`, `UndeliveredMessageExporter.sol`, `L1CrossDomainMessenger.sol`, and `Predeploys.sol` on `develop`. Specs: `interop/message-expiry.md`, `interop/predeploys.md`, and `interop/superchain-eth-bridge.md`.

- **ABIs:** `l2ToL2CrossDomainMessengerAbi`, `superchainETHBridgeAbi`, and `crossL2InboxAbi` are regenerated from the `develop` ABI snapshots. `ethLiquidityAbi` and `undeliveredMessageExporterAbi` are new.
  - `L2ToL2CrossDomainMessenger` gains `expiredMessages(bytes32)`, `sentMessageTimestamps(bytes32)`, `expiryPeriod()`, `expireMessage`, and the `MessageExpired` event. `resendMessage` was removed from the contract, and `sentMessages` is now `mapping(uint256 => bytes32)`.
  - `SuperchainETHBridge` gains `refundETH`, `refunded`, the `RefundETH` event, and new errors.
  - `CrossL2Inbox` gains `CrossL2Inbox_NoExecutingDeposits`.
- **Addresses:** adds `interopContracts.ethLiquidity` (`0x4200…0025`) and `interopContracts.undeliveredMessageExporter` (`0x4200…0030`).
- **New actions** (also on `publicClient.interop` and `walletClient.interop`):
  - `getCrossDomainMessageExpiry` (source chain). Returns `expired`, `sentAt`, `expiryPeriod` (691200 s, 8 days, on production, per `predeploys.md`), and `exportableAfter`. It covers `expiredMessages(bytes32)`. Apps that watch logs can decode the `MessageExpired` event with the updated ABI.
  - `exportUndeliveredMessage` / `estimate…Gas` / `simulate…` (destination chain). This calls `UndeliveredMessageExporter.exportUndeliveredMessage`. The L1 gas limit defaults to 1,000,000, the value the monorepo's message-expiry acceptance test uses (`op-acceptance-tests/tests/interop/expiry`).
  - `refundETH` / `estimateRefundETHGas` / `simulateRefundETH` (source chain). This calls `SuperchainETHBridge.refundETH`. The parameter is `messageNonce` so it does not collide with the transaction `nonce`.
  - `getETHLiquidityPaused`. While paused, `ETHLiquidity` reverts `burn` and `mint` with `ETHLiquidity_Paused`, so `sendETH`, ETH relays, and `refundETH` revert. The JSDoc on `sendETH` notes this.
- **Deprecated:** `sendSuperchainERC20` (and its estimate and simulate variants) and `interopContracts.superchainTokenBridge`. `SuperchainTokenBridge` and `SuperchainERC20` were deleted from the OP Stack contracts in ethereum-optimism/optimism#19999, and `Predeploys.sol` on `develop` and in `op-contracts/v10.0.0-rc.1` has no `0x4200…0028` predeploy. They are kept exported and still work on supersim.
- `hashCrossDomainMessage` now accepts a `CrossDomainMessageFields` (the message without its `log`). The parameter type is wider, so existing callers keep working.

### 3. Withdrawals after the shared-contract migration
- Generated chain definitions (`src/chains/mainnet.ts`, `src/chains/sepolia.ts`) no longer set `contracts.disputeGameFactory`, and `scripts/chaingen.ts` no longer emits it.
  - In viem 2.58.2, `getGames` uses the chain definition's factory first. It falls back to `OptimismPortal2.disputeGameFactory()` only when the definition has none (`op-stack/actions/getGames.ts`).
  - Without the stored address, `getGames`, `getWithdrawalStatus`, `waitToProve`, `getTimeToProve`, and `buildProveWithdrawal` read the factory from the portal. That keeps them working after `OPContractsManagerV2.migrate` repoints OP Mainnet's and Unichain's portals at the shared factory, as the Upgrade 22 notice asks ("read the dispute game factory from `OptimismPortal2.disputeGameFactory()` rather than a stored address").
  - This matches the upstream fix in wevm/viem#5625 (for issue wevm/viem#5623), which makes `getGames` always read the factory from the portal. Until a viem release includes it, leaving the address out of the chain definitions is what makes viem 2.58.2 read the portal. It applies to all generated chains, since any chain's factory can move.
- **Game type `10` (`ZK_DISPUTE_GAME`):** this package has no game-lookup or proving code of its own; it uses `viem/op-stack`. Upstream `superGameTypes` is still `[4, 5, 7, 9]` in 2.58.2. wevm/viem#5625 adds `10` to `superGameTypes`; it is merged but not yet in a viem release. Until a release includes it, `getGames` treats type-`10` games as non-super-root games. It reads their L2 timestamp as a block number and does not use `rootClaimByChainId`. See *Left to do*.

### 4. Post-exec transactions (`0x7D`) and `opGasRefund`
This package defines no chain formatters. Its chains use `viem/op-stack`'s `chainConfig`, so receipt and transaction formatting comes from upstream. wevm/viem#5625 adds `opGasRefund` (as `bigint | null`). The `0x7D` type is tracked in wevm/viem#5623. Until a release includes #5625 (and `0x7D` support lands), `opGasRefund` passes through unformatted as a hex string, and a `0x7D` transaction has no `type`.

## Testing

Run locally with supersim `0.1.0-alpha.60` and anvil:
- `packages/viem`: `build`, `typecheck`, `lint` (0 errors; 4 existing warnings), and `test` (101 passed, 3 skipped). The skipped tests are the existing `sendSuperchainERC20` tests.
- New unit tests:
  - `src/actions/interop/lagoon.spec.ts` covers the ABI surface, the predeploy addresses, and encoding and decoding for the four new actions. It uses a mocked transport, so no node is needed.
  - `src/chains/chains.spec.ts` checks that no generated chain hardcodes `disputeGameFactory` and that OP, Unichain, and their Sepolia chains have a portal.
  - A relay test estimates and simulates `relayMessage` with no fees set.
- `nx affected --base=main --target=build,typecheck,lint,test` passes for all affected projects: `viem`, `wagmi`, `autorelayer-interop`, `ponder-interop`, `sponsored-sender`, `superchain-playground`, `utils-app`, and `supersim`. `ponder-interop:build` only passes from a clean `dist/`, because its build has no clean step; this is not caused by this PR. `wagmi` has no test files.

**Not run locally:**
- `exportUndeliveredMessage`, `refundETH`, `getCrossDomainMessageExpiry`, and `getETHLiquidityPaused` were **not tested against a node**. supersim `0.1.0-alpha.60` predates the Lagoon predeploys, and the full expiry flow needs a finalized withdrawal and a deposit across two chains. These actions are covered only by the calldata and decoding unit tests above.
- Withdrawal proving after the migration was **not tested against a forked OP Mainnet or Unichain**, because the migration has not executed on any network yet. The change relies on viem's existing portal fallback in `getGames`.
- `apps/autorelayer-interop` and `apps/superchain-playground` were built and typechecked but not run.

## Left to do
- **Game type `10` and receipt formatting depend on wevm/viem#5625.** It merged on 2026-11-20, but the latest viem release is still 2.58.2, so this PR sets the peer range to `^2.58.2`. Raise the peer range to the first viem release that contains #5625 once it is published. This must happen before the ZK switch (Sepolia 2026-12-11, Mainnet 2027-01-14).
- `scripts/abigen.ts` still builds from the pinned `lib/optimism` submodule (June 2025), which has no `UndeliveredMessageExporter`. On `develop`, `SuperchainTokenBridge` and `SuperchainERC20` are gone. This PR regenerated the five interop ABIs from the `develop` ABI snapshots instead. Bumping the submodule and teaching `abigen` where to source the deprecated ABIs is a follow-up. Until then, running `gen:abis` would revert these ABIs.
- Once the migration executes, run the withdrawal-proving actions against OP Sepolia and Unichain Sepolia.

topPRs.title: ci: build images with the unified build-images workflow
topPRs.author: falcorocks
topPRs.body:
## Summary

- Replaces the image build caller with the shared `build-images.yaml` reusable workflow from [ethereum-optimism/factory](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/factory), pinned at `9fc2e6aed64fc4acc35dcf967f3746df12cf5e59`. The caller runs on pushes to `main`, release tags (`*/v*`, `v*`), pull requests, merge groups, a daily schedule, and manual dispatch.
- Converts `.github/images.json` to the version 2 catalog. The same three images are declared with the same registry, Dockerfile, targets, build args, and paths. Adds `default_branch_tags: ["latest"]` and `release.publish_tag: "${version}"`.
- Image names and tags are unchanged. A push to `main` publishes `<sha>` and `latest`, as before, plus the branch-name tag `main`. A release tag `<image>/v<semver>` publishes `<sha>` and `v<semver>` with the same `VERSION` build argument as before.
- Verified by running the previous planner from `main` and the new planner on the same change, for a pull request, a push to `main`, and a release tag. Image names, build args, targets, and tags match, except the accepted extra `main` tag on default-branch runs.
- The `latest` alias is published on every trusted default-branch run, including scheduled and manual (`workflow_dispatch`) runs on `main`, not only on pushes.
- Publishing uses the `release` environment, which exists on this repository and allows the `main` branch and the `*/v*` and `v*` tags.

Behaviour differences:

- Pull requests build `amd64` only, on the standard hosted runner, with no registry login and no push. Previously pull requests built both architectures through the Docker build step, which pushes by digest.
- Adds a daily scheduled run at 03:00 UTC. On `main` it is a trusted run and publishes the `latest` and `main` tags.
- Adds `merge_group` triggers. The `develop` branch trigger from the template is omitted because the repository has no such branch.
- `amd64` jobs run on `ubuntu-24.04` (previously `ubuntu-latest`). `arm64` jobs still run on `ubuntu-24.04-arm`.
- Required status: the `result` job of the Build images run fails when any build or publish job fails.
- The `VERSION` value on release tags is no longer exported to the runner environment. It is still passed as the `VERSION` build argument, so image contents are unchanged.

Smoke tests: none. The previous caller did not run smoke tests and none are configured.

Other workflows changed: none. The only workflow in `.github/workflows/` is the image caller replaced here.
